plainTranslation: Mind meets drive. The Mercury person's thinking gets energized and quickened; the Mars person sharpens it into action. Stimulating, decisive, fast. At worst, conversations turn into arguments and words turn into weapons. Failure mode: bickering and cutting remarks. Aim the mental heat at problems, not at each other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
